clips.title: The story
paras: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition offers a trial to those seeking to prove their prowess as big-game stalkers in Stranglethorn Vale. To join Hemet's hunting company, adventurers must first demonstrate their basic tracking ability by taking down ten young panthers.

Within the wild expanse of northern Stranglethorn Vale, Hemet Nesingwary has assembled a seasoned band of big-game huntsmen. Sir S. J. Erlgadin tells anyone who wants a part of the hunt that they must first prove themselves an able panther hunter.
Before Erlgadin entrusts anyone with greater game, he issues an entry test: finding and slaying ten young panthers. Simply finding the beasts is only half the challenge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you want to be a part of the hunt with this crack group Hemet has assembled, you're going to need to prove yourself an able panther hunter. We'll start you out easy -- don't you worry. Let's see you kill 10 young panthers to start.
Tracking them down is only half the challenge...

clips.title: Progress
paras: A true panther hunter would be out in the fields, trying to stalk his prey. Show some commitment to your goal, adventurer, and get back out there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Off to a good start, friend!
